title: "TiNTS epidemiological analysis: elastic-net variable selection"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true

editor: source
---

This document reproduces the elastic-net variable-selection workflow used for the final Cox models, including household-grouped cross-validation and sensitivity across the prespecified alpha grid. Run `01_variable_preparation.qmd` first.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(glmnet)
library(survival)
library(readr)
library(here)

prepared <- readRDS(here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "variable_selection_inputs.rds"))
list2env(prepared, envir = .GlobalEnv)



# --- Outcome (start–stop Cox) ---
risk_intervals <- with(selection_df, Surv(tstart_num, tstop_num, event))

# --- Mask adult/child-specific behaviours ---
selection_df <- selection_df %>%
  mutate(
    smoke_adult_only          = if_else(is_adult == 1L, smoke_adult,          0L),
    drink_alcohol_adult_only  = if_else(is_adult == 1L, drink_alcohol_adult,  0L),
    attend_school_child_only  = if_else(is_child == 1L, attend_school_child,  0L)
  )

# --- Design matrix (no intercept), MAIN EFFECTS ONLY ---
predictors_matrix <- model.matrix(
  ~ water_piped_inside + water_piped_outside + water_borehole + water_unprotected +
    utensil_piped_inside + utensil_piped_outside + utensil_river + utensil_borehole + utensil_unprotected +
    bathe_bottled + bathe_piped_inside + bathe_piped_outside + bathe_borehole + bathe_unprotected +
    food_container + food_refrigerator + food_cupboard + food_surfaces +
    tpt_year + tpt_month + tpt_week + tpt_daily +
    ndir_year + ndir_month + ndir_week + ndir_daily +
    meat_month + meat_year + meat_daily + meat_never +
    fish_month + fish_daily + fish_never +
    is_adult + days_out_day_z + days_out_eve_z + cls_contactnum_z + sleep_next_z +
    goto_market + eat_atcafe + attend_bar + attend_worship +
    hiv_reactive + hiv_unknown + toilet_type_binary + water_treated +
    hand_index_z + veg_handling_index_z + standing_rainwater + flood_last_year +
    shared_plates + river_water_contact + hard_floor + keep_animals + hh_visitors +
    river_distance_z + hours_in_house_z +
    smoke_adult_only + drink_alcohol_adult_only + attend_school_child_only +
    age_yr_z + sex + wealth_index_z - 1,
  data = selection_df
)

# --- Ensure a complete group ID mapping for all columns ---
# col_group_id is a named integer vector linking design-matrix columns to selection groups.
# For any columns missing a group ID, assign unique new group IDs so nothing gets dropped silently.
grp_map <- col_group_id
missing <- setdiff(colnames(predictors_matrix), names(grp_map))
if (length(missing)) {
  grp_map <- c(grp_map, setNames(seq.int(max(grp_map, na.rm = TRUE) + 1L,
                                         max(grp_map, na.rm = TRUE) + length(missing)),
                                 missing))
}
grp_map <- grp_map[colnames(predictors_matrix)]  # align order

# --- Household-grouped CV folds (avoid leakage) ---
set.seed(1)
k_folds <- min(10L, length(unique(selection_df$hhid)))
households <- unique(selection_df$hhid)
household_to_fold <- setNames(sample(rep(seq_len(k_folds), length.out = length(households))), households)
fold_by_household <- as.integer(household_to_fold[as.character(selection_df$hhid)])

# --- Elastic Net CV with relaxed path (so we can reach ≥ 12 groups) ---
set.seed(1)
elastic_cv <- cv.glmnet(
  x = predictors_matrix,
  y = risk_intervals,
  family = "cox",
  alpha = 0.15,
  type.measure = "C",
  standardize = TRUE,
  foldid = fold_by_household,
  nlambda = 500,
  lambda.min.ratio = 1e-5,
  pmax = ncol(predictors_matrix),
  relax = TRUE
)

# --- Count groups active at each lambda; pick first λ with ≥ 12 groups ---
glmnet_fit <- elastic_cv$glmnet.fit
beta_mat   <- as.matrix(coef(glmnet_fit))                 # rows = vars, cols = lambdas
nz_mask    <- beta_mat != 0
# Simpler: for each lambda, compute # of unique groups among nonzero vars
nnz_groups <- integer(ncol(beta_mat))
for (j in seq_len(ncol(beta_mat))) {
  nz_vars <- rownames(beta_mat)[nz_mask[, j]]
  nnz_groups[j] <- length(unique(grp_map[nz_vars]))
}

target_groups <- 12L
idx_ge <- which(nnz_groups >= target_groups)

lambda_star <- if (length(idx_ge)) glmnet_fit$lambda[min(idx_ge)] else min(glmnet_fit$lambda)

# --- At lambda_star, identify selected groups and trim to exactly 12 if needed ---
coef_star <- as.numeric(beta_mat[, which(glmnet_fit$lambda == lambda_star)])
names(coef_star) <- rownames(beta_mat)

active_vars   <- names(coef_star)[coef_star != 0]
active_groups <- unique(grp_map[active_vars])

if (length(active_groups) > target_groups) {
  # Rank groups by the largest absolute coefficient within the group at lambda_star
  grp_strength <- tapply(abs(coef_star[names(grp_map)]), grp_map, max, na.rm = TRUE)
  keep_groups  <- names(sort(grp_strength[as.character(active_groups)], decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(target_groups)]
  active_groups <- as.integer(keep_groups)
}

# --- Expand to ALL variables in the selected groups (group-keeping rule) ---
selected_terms <- names(grp_map)[grp_map %in% active_groups]

# --- Always force adjusters (and avoid duplicates) ---
forced_adjusters <- c("age_yr_z","sex","wealth_index_z")
selected_terms <- unique(c(selected_terms, forced_adjusters))

# Save the primary selected terms and group identifiers.
dir.create(here::here("outputs", "reproducibility"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
primary_selection <- tibble(
  term = selected_terms,
  group_id = unname(grp_map[selected_terms]),
  forced_adjuster = selected_terms %in% forced_adjusters
)
write_csv(
  primary_selection,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "elastic_net_primary_selected_terms.csv")
)

# ============================================================
# 14e. Elastic net alpha/lambda sensitivity analysis
# ============================================================
# Purpose:
#   Sensitivity analysis for the data-driven variable selection step.
#
#   We vary the elastic net mixing parameter (alpha) and inspect the
#   lambda path for each alpha. For each alpha, we identify the sparsest
#   lambda solution that reaches approximately the prespecified target of
#   12 candidate selection units.
#
#   IMPORTANT:
#   - Forced adjusters (age, sex, wealth) are included in the penalised Cox
#     design matrix but are given penalty.factor = 0 and are NOT counted
#     toward the 12 candidate predictors.
#   - Grouped categorical predictors count as one candidate selection unit.
#     For example, all water-source dummies count as the parent group
#     "water_source".
#   - If a lambda step jumps from <12 to >12 groups, groups are trimmed back
#     to 12 using the largest absolute coefficient within each group. This
#     mirrors the main analytic logic while making the tuning sensitivity
#     explicit and auditable.
#
# Outputs are written to outputs/reproducibility/.


# ----------------------------
# 0) User-controlled settings
# ----------------------------

alpha_grid <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00)

target_candidate_units <- 12L

# For the "near-target" stability analysis:
# e.g. target +/- 2 means models with 10-14 active candidate units
target_neighbourhood <- 2L

n_lambda_sensitivity <- 500L
lambda_min_ratio_sensitivity <- 1e-5
set.seed(1)

# ----------------------------
# 1) Safety checks
# ----------------------------

stopifnot(exists("selection_df"))
stopifnot(exists("predictors_matrix"))
stopifnot(exists("col_group_id"))
stopifnot(exists("group_map"))

stopifnot(all(c("tstart_num", "tstop_num", "event", "hhid") %in% names(selection_df)))

if (nrow(predictors_matrix) != nrow(selection_df)) {
  stop(
    "predictors_matrix and selection_df have different row numbers. ",
    "Recreate predictors_matrix using the same rows as selection_df before running this sensitivity chunk."
  )
}

# Outcome
risk_intervals_sens <- with(selection_df, Surv(tstart_num, tstop_num, event))

# Complete-case rows for glmnet
complete_rows <- complete.cases(predictors_matrix) &
  is.finite(selection_df$tstart_num) &
  is.finite(selection_df$tstop_num) &
  !is.na(selection_df$event)

if (sum(!complete_rows) > 0) {
  message("Dropping ", sum(!complete_rows), " rows with incomplete outcome or predictor data for sensitivity analysis.")
}

x_sens <- predictors_matrix[complete_rows, , drop = FALSE]
y_sens <- risk_intervals_sens[complete_rows]
dat_sens <- selection_df[complete_rows, , drop = FALSE]

# ----------------------------
# 2) Household-grouped folds
# ----------------------------
# Use existing fold_by_household if available and correctly sized;
# otherwise recreate fixed household-level folds.

if (exists("fold_by_household") && length(fold_by_household) == nrow(selection_df)) {
  foldid_sens <- fold_by_household[complete_rows]
} else {
  set.seed(1)
  k_folds <- min(10L, length(unique(dat_sens$hhid)))
  households <- unique(dat_sens$hhid)

  household_to_fold <- setNames(
    sample(rep(seq_len(k_folds), length.out = length(households))),
    households
  )

  foldid_sens <- as.integer(household_to_fold[as.character(dat_sens$hhid)])
}

# ----------------------------
# 3) Align group map to design matrix columns
# ----------------------------

grp_map_sens <- col_group_id

missing_from_group_map <- setdiff(colnames(x_sens), names(grp_map_sens))

if (length(missing_from_group_map) > 0) {
  grp_map_sens <- c(
    grp_map_sens,
    setNames(
      seq.int(
        max(grp_map_sens, na.rm = TRUE) + 1L,
        max(grp_map_sens, na.rm = TRUE) + length(missing_from_group_map)
      ),
      missing_from_group_map
    )
  )
}

grp_map_sens <- grp_map_sens[colnames(x_sens)]

if (any(is.na(grp_map_sens))) {
  stop("Some columns in x_sens still do not have a group ID.")
}

# ----------------------------
# 4) Forced adjusters
# ----------------------------
# These are included but not penalised and not counted toward the 12.
# This handles both numeric columns and possible model.matrix expansion of sex.

forced_cols <- grep(
  pattern = "^(age_yr_z|wealth_index_z)$|^sex",
  x = colnames(x_sens),
  value = TRUE
)

if (length(forced_cols) == 0) {
  warning("No forced adjuster columns identified in predictors_matrix. Check age/sex/wealth names.")
}

penalty_factor <- ifelse(colnames(x_sens) %in% forced_cols, 0, 1)

candidate_cols <- setdiff(colnames(x_sens), forced_cols)

# ----------------------------
# 5) Human-readable selection-unit labels
# ----------------------------

group_id_to_label <- tibble(
  term = names(grp_map_sens),
  group_id = as.integer(grp_map_sens)
) %>%
  mutate(
    selection_unit = case_when(
      group_id %in% seq_along(group_map) ~ names(group_map)[group_id],
      TRUE ~ term
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(group_id, selection_unit)

lookup_unit <- function(group_ids) {
  group_id_to_label$selection_unit[
    match(as.integer(group_ids), group_id_to_label$group_id)
  ]
}

# ----------------------------
# 6) Helper functions
# ----------------------------

count_candidate_units_at_lambda <- function(beta_j, grp_map, candidate_cols) {
  active_terms <- names(beta_j)[beta_j != 0]
  active_candidate_terms <- intersect(active_terms, candidate_cols)

  tibble(
    n_candidate_terms = length(active_candidate_terms),
    n_candidate_units = length(unique(grp_map[active_candidate_terms]))
  )
}

extract_target_solution <- function(cv_fit, alpha_value, target_units) {

  glmnet_fit <- cv_fit$glmnet.fit
  beta_mat <- as.matrix(coef(glmnet_fit))
  lambda_vec <- glmnet_fit$lambda

  # Count active candidate terms and candidate selection units at each lambda
  path_counts <- map_dfr(seq_along(lambda_vec), function(j) {
    beta_j <- beta_mat[, j]
    names(beta_j) <- rownames(beta_mat)

    out <- count_candidate_units_at_lambda(
      beta_j = beta_j,
      grp_map = grp_map_sens,
      candidate_cols = candidate_cols
    )

    tibble(
      alpha = alpha_value,
      lambda_index = j,
      lambda = lambda_vec[j],
      log_lambda = log(lambda_vec[j]),
      cvm = cv_fit$cvm[match(lambda_vec[j], cv_fit$lambda)],
      cvsd = cv_fit$cvsd[match(lambda_vec[j], cv_fit$lambda)],
      n_candidate_terms = out$n_candidate_terms,
      n_candidate_units = out$n_candidate_units
    )
  })

  # Identify the sparsest lambda that reaches >= target units
  idx_ge_target <- which(path_counts$n_candidate_units >= target_units)

  if (length(idx_ge_target) > 0) {
    chosen_index <- min(idx_ge_target)
    target_reached <- TRUE
  } else {
    chosen_index <- which.min(abs(path_counts$n_candidate_units - target_units))
    target_reached <- FALSE
  }

  lambda_target <- path_counts$lambda[chosen_index]

  beta_target <- beta_mat[, chosen_index]
  names(beta_target) <- rownames(beta_mat)

  active_terms <- names(beta_target)[beta_target != 0]
  active_candidate_terms <- intersect(active_terms, candidate_cols)

  active_candidate_groups <- unique(grp_map_sens[active_candidate_terms])

  # Rank active groups by the largest absolute coefficient in the group
  group_strength <- tibble(
    term = active_candidate_terms,
    group_id = as.integer(grp_map_sens[active_candidate_terms]),
    abs_beta = abs(beta_target[active_candidate_terms])
  ) %>%
    group_by(group_id) %>%
    summarise(
      max_abs_beta = max(abs_beta, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_abs_beta))

  # If lambda jump gives more than 12, trim to the strongest 12 groups
  selected_group_ids <- group_strength$group_id

  trimmed_to_target <- FALSE

  if (length(selected_group_ids) > target_units) {
    selected_group_ids <- selected_group_ids[seq_len(target_units)]
    trimmed_to_target <- TRUE
  }

  selected_units <- lookup_unit(selected_group_ids)

  # Expand selected groups back to all corresponding design-matrix columns
  selected_terms_expanded <- names(grp_map_sens)[grp_map_sens %in% selected_group_ids]
  selected_terms_expanded <- intersect(selected_terms_expanded, colnames(x_sens))
  selected_terms_expanded <- setdiff(selected_terms_expanded, forced_cols)

  # Also save active terms before group expansion
  active_units_untrimmed <- lookup_unit(active_candidate_groups)

  summary_row <- tibble(
    alpha = alpha_value,
    chosen_lambda = lambda_target,
    chosen_log_lambda = log(lambda_target),
    target_reached = target_reached,
    trimmed_to_target = trimmed_to_target,
    n_candidate_units_before_trimming = length(active_candidate_groups),
    n_candidate_units_after_trimming = length(selected_group_ids),
    n_candidate_terms_active = length(active_candidate_terms),
    n_candidate_terms_after_group_expansion = length(selected_terms_expanded),
    cvm_at_chosen_lambda = path_counts$cvm[chosen_index],
    best_cvm_for_alpha = max(path_counts$cvm, na.rm = TRUE),
    delta_cvm_from_best = max(path_counts$cvm, na.rm = TRUE) - path_counts$cvm[chosen_index],
    selected_units = paste(selected_units, collapse = "; "),
    selected_terms_expanded = paste(selected_terms_expanded, collapse = "; "),
    active_units_before_trimming = paste(active_units_untrimmed, collapse = "; ")
  )

  selected_units_long <- tibble(
    alpha = alpha_value,
    chosen_lambda = lambda_target,
    group_id = selected_group_ids,
    selection_unit = selected_units
  )

  active_near_target_long <- path_counts %>%
    filter(
      n_candidate_units >= target_units - target_neighbourhood,
      n_candidate_units <= target_units + target_neighbourhood
    ) %>%
    select(alpha, lambda_index, lambda, log_lambda, cvm, n_candidate_units) %>%
    mutate(
      active_units = map(lambda_index, function(j) {
        beta_j <- beta_mat[, j]
        names(beta_j) <- rownames(beta_mat)

        active_terms_j <- names(beta_j)[beta_j != 0]
        active_candidate_terms_j <- intersect(active_terms_j, candidate_cols)
        active_groups_j <- unique(grp_map_sens[active_candidate_terms_j])

        lookup_unit(active_groups_j)
      })
    ) %>%
    unnest(active_units, names_repair = "minimal") %>%
    rename(selection_unit = active_units)

  list(
    path_counts = path_counts,
    summary_row = summary_row,
    selected_units_long = selected_units_long,
    active_near_target_long = active_near_target_long,
    cv_fit = cv_fit
  )
}

# ----------------------------
# 7) Fit cv.glmnet across alpha values
# ----------------------------

fit_one_alpha <- function(alpha_value) {

  message("Fitting elastic net sensitivity model for alpha = ", alpha_value)

  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    x = x_sens,
    y = y_sens,
    family = "cox",
    alpha = alpha_value,
    type.measure = "C",
    standardize = TRUE,
    foldid = foldid_sens,
    nlambda = n_lambda_sensitivity,
    lambda.min.ratio = lambda_min_ratio_sensitivity,
    penalty.factor = penalty_factor,
    pmax = ncol(x_sens),
    maxit = 100000
  )

  extract_target_solution(
    cv_fit = cv_fit,
    alpha_value = alpha_value,
    target_units = target_candidate_units
  )
}

sensitivity_fits <- map(alpha_grid, fit_one_alpha)

# ----------------------------
# 8) Bind outputs
# ----------------------------

sens_path_df <- map_dfr(sensitivity_fits, "path_counts")

target12_summary <- map_dfr(sensitivity_fits, "summary_row")

target12_selected_units <- map_dfr(sensitivity_fits, "selected_units_long")

near_target_selected_units <- map_dfr(sensitivity_fits, "active_near_target_long")

target12_selection_frequency <- target12_selected_units %>%
  count(selection_unit, name = "n_alpha_selected") %>%
  mutate(
    n_alpha_tested = length(alpha_grid),
    proportion_alpha_selected = n_alpha_selected / n_alpha_tested
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(proportion_alpha_selected), selection_unit)

near_target_selection_frequency <- near_target_selected_units %>%
  distinct(alpha, lambda_index, selection_unit) %>%
  count(selection_unit, name = "n_near_target_models_selected") %>%
  mutate(
    n_near_target_models = near_target_selected_units %>%
      distinct(alpha, lambda_index) %>%
      nrow(),
    proportion_near_target_models_selected =
      n_near_target_models_selected / n_near_target_models
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(proportion_near_target_models_selected), selection_unit)

# ----------------------------
# 9) Save tables
# ----------------------------

dir.create(here::here("outputs", "reproducibility"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  sens_path_df,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "elasticnet_alpha_lambda_path_summary.csv")
)

write_csv(
  target12_summary,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "elasticnet_alpha_target12_summary.csv")
)

write_csv(
  target12_selected_units,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "elasticnet_alpha_target12_selected_units.csv")
)

write_csv(
  target12_selection_frequency,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "elasticnet_alpha_target12_selection_frequency.csv")
)

write_csv(
  near_target_selection_frequency,
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "elasticnet_near_target_selection_frequency.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    elastic_cv = elastic_cv,
    lambda_star = lambda_star,
    selected_terms = selected_terms,
    forced_adjusters = forced_adjusters,
    target12_summary = target12_summary,
    target12_selected_units = target12_selected_units,
    target12_selection_frequency = target12_selection_frequency
  ),
  here::here("outputs", "reproducibility", "elastic_net_results.rds")
)
```
